start: if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh && sudo sh /tmp/get-docker.sh && rm /tmp/get-docker.sh && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER || true; fi && (sudo systemctl start docker 2>/dev/null || sudo service docker start 2>/dev/null || sudo dockerd > /dev/null 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && until docker info > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done

terminals.name: PostgreSQL Database
terminals.command: bun run db:start && echo 'Waiting for PostgreSQL to be ready...' && timeout 60 bash -c 'until docker exec alfred-postgres pg_isready -U alfred > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && echo 'PostgreSQL is ready!'
